summary: Add one concise, non-functional documentation note recording the final H7 clean end-to-end verification.
scope: Locate the existing project documentation most appropriate for verification notes.
Add exactly one harmless note stating that the final H7 clean E2E verification was completed.
Review the diff to confirm no runtime, configuration, or test behavior changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Exactly one documentation note for final H7 clean E2E verification is added.
